concepts.proposed_markdown: The 2026-08-28 Get Invoice schema independently describes `Invoice.billable_status` as indicating whether the invoice has been or will be sent to the configured customer billing provider and says it defaults to `billable`. The property simultaneously references `BillableStatus` and declares sibling `type: object`, so its documented shape remains internally unresolved on this page. warnings: Do not normalize the property to either the referenced string shape or the sibling object shape; this page documents both.

concepts.anchor: Append in `### Balance retrieval and ledger calculation` immediately after the 2026-08-28 List-schema access_type paragraph, preserving separate List, Get, and mutation authority.
concepts.proposed_markdown: The 2026-08-28 Get Invoice schema exposes `InvoiceLineItem.quantity_consumed` on applied-commit lines for quantity-based commits and describes it as the unit quantity deducted from the commit. Its `AppliedCommitOrCredit` component requires only `id` and `type`; feature-annotated `access_type` distinguishes `SPEND`, which deducts the dollar cost of usage, from `QUANTITY`, which deducts units. This response component states no default. [[source-metronome-api-reference-invoices-get-an-invoice]]
warnings: Keep InvoiceLineItem.quantity_consumed at its immediate parent and access_type under AppliedCommitOrCredit; neither is a top-level Invoice property.
